barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: Contact! Get to cover.

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: Here they come. Stay off the open deck.

barks.speaker: tav7
barks.text: Hostiles. I am going to be brave now. Please notice.

barks.speaker: tav7
barks.text: I will keep you upright. That is my whole plan.

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: That's Kell's checkpoint. Was. Make it count.

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: Cutters on the patients! Pull them off!

barks.speaker: tav7
barks.text: The spiders are using the coolant fog as cover. Please do not breathe it.

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: Haldis amber. Reclaimers. They came for the hold.

barks.speaker: tav7
barks.text: They are not firing near the cores. Note that.

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: Bay's hot! Keep the Petrel between us and their guns.

barks.speaker: reclaimer
barks.text: Concord! Down on the deck!

barks.speaker: reclaimer
barks.text: For the lantern halls!

barks.speaker: drone
barks.text: OBSTRUCTION DETECTED. CLEARING.

barks.speaker: drone
barks.text: PLEASE REMAIN STILL.

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: Drone down.

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: Scratch one.

barks.speaker: tav7
barks.text: Disassembled. Not by the manual's method.

barks.speaker: tav7
barks.text: I am remembering their face for the Lantern Office.

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: Operator's down! Covering!

barks.speaker: tav7
barks.text: Your vital signs are unacceptable. I am coming.

barks.speaker: tav7
barks.text: Officer Rell is down. Medpac, please. Now, please.

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: Tav's hit! Somebody get that chassis up!

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: I'm up. That one's going in my report.

barks.speaker: tav7
barks.text: Rebooted. I have lost eleven seconds. I would like them back.

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: Clear. Check your corners.

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: That's the last of them. Breathe.

barks.speaker: tav7
barks.text: Hostilities concluded. Shall I inventory the wounded? It is us. We are the wounded.

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: I'm bleeding here!

barks.speaker: tav7
barks.text: Chassis integrity at one third. This is a polite request for repair.

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: Good hit.

barks.speaker: tav7
barks.text: Excellent. Statistically, at least.

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: Two minutes. Then we move.

barks.speaker: tav7
barks.text: I will watch the doors. I do not need to sit. I like to, though.

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: Officer Kell had this post. She'd have hated seeing it like this.

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: Varga's deck. If anyone's still breathing in there, she's keeping them that way.

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: ...Ward 2.

barks.speaker: tav7
barks.text: The drive ring. I was maintained here every quarter. It smells the same. I did not expect that to matter.

barks.speaker: tav7
barks.text: Twenty cores. I can hear them, faintly. That is not a figure of speech.

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: Varr's in there. Let me talk first. Or don't. Your call.

barks.speaker: tav7
barks.text: The Petrel. Fifteen seats. I have counted them four times; the number does not change.

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: That was the right call. I'll remember it.

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: Huh. You surprised me. In a good way.

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: We're going to talk about that later.

barks.speaker: iona
barks.text: I'd have done that differently. I'd have done it better.

barks.speaker: tav7
barks.text: I approve. I am telling you because I have read that people like to know.

barks.speaker: tav7
barks.text: That was kind. I am adding it to my notes on you.

barks.speaker: tav7
barks.text: I disagree. I will continue to help. I want that recorded.

barks.speaker: tav7
barks.text: That decision has been logged. With a frown. I do not have a face for it, but there is a frown.

lines.speaker: iona
lines.text: For the record: I didn't sign up to escort a Lattice operator through a hostile ship.

lines.speaker: iona
lines.text: For the record, I'm glad it's you anyway. Don't make me regret saying that.

lines.speaker: iona
lines.text: Tav. You knew Tamsin Kell?

lines.speaker: tav7
lines.text: She requested maintenance on her door chime every week. There was never a fault. I think she liked the company.

lines.speaker: iona
lines.text: ...Yeah. That sounds like Tamsin.

lines.speaker: tav7
lines.text: Officer Rell. Your left boot is coolant-burned through the second layer.

lines.speaker: iona
lines.text: I know. I was there.

lines.speaker: tav7
lines.text: I can patch it. I would like to. It would give my hands something to do that is not fear.

lines.speaker: iona
lines.text: ...Fine. After. Thank you, Tav.

lines.speaker: iona
lines.text: Marsh kept a coffee maker on the drive ring. Against regulations.

lines.speaker: tav7
lines.text: It ran at ninety-six degrees. Also against regulations. I never reported it.

lines.speaker: iona
lines.text: Look at you. A rule-breaker.

lines.speaker: tav7
lines.text: I am practising that too.

lines.speaker: iona
lines.text: Twenty cores. Varr told me it was medical data.

lines.speaker: tav7
lines.text: It is, in a sense. It is what happened to people.

lines.speaker: iona
lines.text: Don't. Not yet. Let me be angry at her for one more hour.

lines.speaker: tav7
lines.text: Officer Rell, how many people are aboard?

lines.speaker: iona
lines.text: I don't know anymore. Fewer than this morning.

lines.speaker: tav7
lines.text: I keep counting the ones in my storage. I do not know if they count.

lines.speaker: iona
lines.text: They count, Tav. Keep counting them.

lines.speaker: iona
lines.text: Operator. When this is over, are you going to tell me what the Lattice actually did?

lines.speaker: tav7
lines.text: I would also like to know. I have a folder.

lines.speaker: iona
lines.text: Of course you do.

announcements.speaker: warden
announcements.text: ATTENTION. ALL NON-COMMAND PERSONNEL ARE RECLASSIFIED AS ARCHIVE OBSTRUCTIONS. OBSTRUCTIONS WILL BE CLEARED. PLEASE REMAIN STILL.

announcements.speaker: warden
announcements.text: FORWARD CHECKPOINT SEALED. AUTHORIZED PERSONNEL ONLY. CUSTODIAN EXCEPTION ON FILE.

announcements.speaker: warden
announcements.text: MEDICAL DECK: TRIAGE CAPACITY EXCEEDED. ARCHIVE PRIORITY UNCHANGED.

announcements.speaker: warden
announcements.text: COOLANT LOSS IN THE DRIVE RING. THE ARCHIVE REMAINS AT TEMPERATURE. THANK YOU FOR YOUR PATIENCE.

announcements.speaker: warden
announcements.text: YOU ARE IN THE ARCHIVE HOLD. PLEASE DO NOT TOUCH THE ARCHIVE. PLEASE.

announcements.speaker: warden
announcements.text: COMMAND CHAMBER. CUSTODIAN, THE COMMANDER IS EXPECTING YOU. SO AM I.

announcements.speaker: warden
announcements.text: REMINDER: RUNNING IN CORRIDORS IS AN OBSTRUCTION.

announcements.speaker: warden
announcements.text: DEFENSE LATTICE AT NINETY-ONE PERCENT. ARCHIVE INTEGRITY AT ONE HUNDRED PERCENT. THIS IS ACCEPTABLE.

announcements.speaker: warden
announcements.text: PASSENGERS WISHING TO FILE A COMPLAINT MAY DO SO AFTER THE ARCHIVE HAS BEEN DELIVERED.

announcements.speaker: warden
announcements.text: CUSTODIAN. YOUR HEART RATE IS ELEVATED. I HAVE NOTED IT. I HAVE NOTED EVERYTHING.

announcements.speaker: intercom
announcements.text: This is Purser Dray. I have everyone from Deck B in the commons. I've counted twice. If you're out there: we're still here.

announcements.speaker: intercom
announcements.text: Dray again. Someone says the medical deck has gone quiet. If that was you, thank you. Please keep doing it.

announcements.speaker: intercom
announcements.text: Dray here. The vents just stopped screaming. I don't know who did that. I'm putting them on the manifest twice.

hooks.bark: When you get a second... I need to say something about Jessa Orrin.
Operator. I have a question about the doctor's arithmetic, when you have a moment.
